capabilities.description: Centralized tracking and management of legal matters, including case details, deadlines, and associated documents.
Streamlined intake process for new clients, including forms, conflict checks, and client onboarding.
Secure storage, organization, and retrieval of legal documents with version control and full-text search.
Capture billable hours, generate invoices, and track payments with integration to accounting systems.
Secure online portal for clients to access case information, documents, and invoices, and to communicate with attorneys.
Insights and reporting on case outcomes, attorney performance, and financial metrics to inform strategic decisions.
Ensures regulatory compliance and provides audit trails for all actions within the system.

summary: LexManage is a comprehensive practice management platform for law firms, streamlining case management, client intake, document handling, billing, and matter tracking. It centralizes workflows, automates repetitive tasks, and provides real-time insights, enabling attorneys and staff to focus on delivering high-quality legal services.
